item.title: Blit 0.2.46
item.description: Watch mode now asks qBittorrent whether each download has finished. When qBittorrent runs on the server, Blit reads its own records (no qBittorrent login needed) and fetches a torrent only once qBittorrent has completed it, so a stalled torrent is never fetched however long its files have been quiet; Settings › Watch shows how far along each one is. qBittorrent's incomplete folder is never fetched. Downloads from other clients still wait until their files have stopped changing.
